source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
This is exciting!

Before we lock in the letterforms, I'd like to spend one more round exploring the overall composition.

Would you please show a few variations that explore:

slightly tighter optical spacing throughout the word (without feeling compressed), and
the letterforms sitting on a common baseline, so the bottom point of both Vs aligns with the baseline established by the E and L.

I'd like to compare a few compositions before we finalize the spacing and overall rhythm.

value_updates.alignment_rule: The bottom points of both Vs align with the baseline established by the E and L.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text:
Hi Brittany,

Here is the comparison proof exploring both the common baseline alignment and the tighter optical kerning!

Common Baseline Alignment: The bottom points of both the Hero V and the second V now sit flush on the exact baseline established by the flat feet of the E and L characters (guided by the baseline rules).

Variation A (Standard Spacing): Keeps the common baseline while maintaining our previous open optical spacing.

Variation B (Tighter Kerning): Applies a slightly tighter, more cohesive kerning rhythm across the letterforms while maintaining a luxurious, balanced feel.

I’d love to know which spacing rhythm feels most cohesive to you as we finalize the master wordmark

execution.observed_behavior: Freelancer reports that both V bottom points sit flush on the baseline established by the E and L feet in both comparison variations.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
This was very productive. I prefer Variation B with the common baseline and tighter kerning.

**I'd like to see the Es and Ls scaled so their height aligns with the height established by the left arm of the second V,** allowing the second V's right arm to remain the only element that extends slightly above them as the intentional signature detail. At the moment, the second V still feels noticeably smaller than the surrounding letters. Please also make sure the accent is a perfect copy/paste of the right arm of the Hero V.

execution.observed_behavior: After reviewing the comparison proof, the client selects Variation B with the common baseline.
